Chapter 514: Chapter 12 Great Scholar Tai’e: When did you also become a great scholar? (Please subscribe)_2

“`

Why does the cosmic force realized by an invincible eighth-layer practitioner offer great benefits during ninth-layer cultivation?

It is because the cosmic force is the fundamental power of the universe starry skies in the main world, realized and fused into the pillar rules at the eighth layer, transforming the inner world and imbuing it with a trace of the cosmic starry skies’ fundamental power.

When the inner world ascends to an inner universe, it will act as a catalyst.

“With the cosmic force at your command, coupled with the World Tree’s suppression, ascending your inner world to an inner universe in the future should pose no difficulties. The only thing you need to be mindful of is what kind of inner universe will be ascended to.”

The Stone Statue Shen Ji gazed at Lin Yuan.

...

Even among inner universes, there are distinctions between strong and weak.

The Stone Statue Shen Ji was curious about what degree Lin Yuan’s future inner universe would reach: dozens of ordinary cosmic forces, more than ten superior cosmic forces, plus one source-level cosmic force.

What kind of inner universe will it form?

“It’s a pity that the upper limit of your race is not high; even if you fully comprehend the complete space rules, the maximum extent of your inner world would be tens of millions of miles. If it could be a bit larger…”

The stone statue spoke up to this point, then suddenly laughed. What was it thinking? Even if the inner world was only tens of millions of miles in extent, with so many cosmic forces integrated, it could turn decay into magic.

Lin Yuan was about to speak.

His expression suddenly changed slightly.

“The Goddess of Freedom is looking for me?”

A thought crossed Lin Yuan’s mind.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

The voice of the Goddess of Freedom suddenly reached Lin Yuan’s ears.

“Respected Scholar Yuan…”

Compared to the solemn and aloof voice of the Goddess of Wisdom, the voice of the Goddess of Freedom was filled with coldness and a killing intent, making it very distinctive.

“Goddess of Freedom.”

Lin Yuan’s tone was slightly solemn.

In human civilization, the status of the three goddesses is not less than that of the nine Supreme Beings. Over more than two million years, the three ultimate AI goddesses have made indelible contributions.

Very soon.

The Goddess of Freedom conveyed the invitation from the B0001 Exotic Battlefield to Lin Yuan.

“You want me to go to this battlefield of different races to confront numerous strong ones from the Tianyu Clan?” Lin Yuan raised his eyebrows slightly.

“As long as I agree, will I receive one-tenth of the total merit from the upcoming war?” Lin Yuan was somewhat tempted.

The B0001 Exotic Battlefield had arrangements from the human civilization and the Tianyu Clan’s numerous strong ones involved, hence the associated merit was naturally colossal; even just one-tenth was probably in the tens of millions.

“Just by making a move once, could I at least obtain tens of millions of merit points?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

With Lin Yuan’s strength, naturally, he would make a move at the most critical moment to turn the tide of battle, which meant he would likely only act once.

“Goddess of Freedom, will there be any ninth-layer or tenth-layer strong ones taking action on this battlefield of different races?” Lin Yuan thought for a moment, then asked.

“On a medium-sized otherworldly battlefield, strong ones of the ninth layer and above rarely enter. And even if they do, there are evolvers from our human civilization of the ninth layer and above to face them,” the Goddess of Freedom said in a cold voice, as if devoid of any emotion.

“So if I go to this battlefield, will there be any accidents, like being cursed and killed along with all my avatars by the different species’ strong ones?” Lin Yuan continued to inquire.

At any time, one’s own safety is the most important. If Lin Yuan would have to risk his life for some merit points, he naturally would not wish for that.

Merit points, for Lin Yuan, have a stable path of acquisition, and there’s no need to take any unnecessary risks.

“As the first medium-sized otherworldly battlefield to be developed, it will be under the watch of a Supreme Being. Scholar Yuan only needs to focus on fighting the eighth-layer strong ones of the different species,” the Goddess of Freedom spoke again.

Giving Lin Yuan’s importance to human civilization, now that the Goddess of Freedom had agreed to let Lin Yuan go to the battlefield, it naturally followed extensive deduction, ensuring that there would be no real risk of death for Lin Yuan.

Previously, when Lin Yuan had yet to step into the seventh rank, he wanted to venture into a medium-sized otherworldly battlefield but was stopped by the Goddess of Wisdom.

It was because, at that time, Lin Yuan had a minimal chance of encountering insurmountable dangers in the medium-sized otherworldly battlefield that could involve the original body of his avatars.

“Only eighth-layer strong ones of the different species, eh…” Lin Yuan’s face revealed a smile.

“Then I agree.” Lin Yuan nodded. With his current strength, not to mention he was the first in the eighth layer in the history of human civilization, perhaps even among all the eighth-layer individuals throughout the history of the Starry Sky Races, none could compare to him.

In that battle in the Milky Way Star Region, Lin Yuan had not regained full strength nor had he displayed all his power.

Even so, it still shook the internal units of human civilization, and the shock experienced by the surrounding different species was probably even more profound.

Lin Yuan’s true combat power had long since broken the threshold of the ninth rank. As for what level within the ninth rank he was, only a battle could reveal that.

…

Upon receiving Lin Yuan’s consent, the Goddess of Freedom immediately contacted the invincible eighth-layer evolver on the B0001 battlefield.

“`

Not long after, they were required to meet in the Virtual World to discuss the specific requirements for making a move.

“Void Interpretation”…”

Lin Yuan once again started to contemplate the tome left by the Moyu Tower Master.

“It’s truly profound…” Lin Yuan was somewhat engrossed, “Void Interpretation” comprised of three thousand three hundred and thirty-three characters, each seemingly containing endless information.

Each time Lin Yuan contemplated, he could discern new aspects of the essence of space from the same character.

In the blink of an eye, Lin Yuan had contemplated for several days.

“The seven thousand one hundred and thirty-second spatial model…”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, his thoughts stirred slightly, and strands of spatial force converged before him, quickly forming an incredibly complex spatial model.

“Just over five hundred more spatial models and I can fully comprehend the Complete Space Rules.”

Lin Yuan let out a breath, while also sensing the weariness in his soul.

“Void Interpretation” was on such a high level that Lin Yuan’s prolonged contemplation took a great toll on his Heart Force, making it impossible to maintain for long periods.

This had nothing to do with “Against-Heaven’s Understanding”; it was primarily due to Lin Yuan himself. If his Heart Force were sufficient, he could continue contemplating indefinitely.

“Let’s take a look at the Virtual World.”

Lin Yuan connected his consciousness to the Virtual World, intending to relax for a while.

“Founder’s Virtual World…” Lin Yuan’s consciousness directly entered.

This Virtual World was specifically created for the founders of many paths of evolution within human civilization, serving as a place for the founders to communicate daily.

Lin Yuan had just entered the Founders’ World.

The Great Scholar Tai’e appeared beside Lin Yuan.

In the public area of the Founders’ World, every founder had the right to enter.

“Kid, it’s been a long time since you’ve been online.” The Great Scholar Tai’e looked Lin Yuan over, and asked with slight curiosity.

The Great Scholar Tai’e was exceptionally curious about Lin Yuan; if not for the Goddess of Wisdom’s intervention and warning, he would have likely used some methods to forcibly pull out Lin Yuan’s real identity.

“I’ve been a bit busy,” Lin Yuan replied truthfully.

It was more than just a bit; the things Lin Yuan needed to do were simply too numerous: “Void Interpretation,” Fusion Rules, the Nine Floors Dark Tower, and so forth.

Each required a great deal of time and energy.

“Being busy is good.”

The Great Scholar Tai’e nodded.

“By the way.”

“In a while, the Molang Scholar plans to create a Virtual World specifically to discuss the essence of the Space Rules and Rule of Time, are you interested in going?”

The Great Scholar Tai’e glanced at Lin Yuan.

The Molang Scholar was one of the few scholars in the Founder’s Virtual World who openly revealed their identity.

The reason for this was that the Molang Scholar was one of the most top-tier and ancient scholars within human civilization. His identity, even when made public, would not be affected.

“The essence of the Rule of Time and Space Rules?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up; so far, he had no particular interest in the Rule of Time,

but Space Rules? Even with the “Void Interpretation” left by the Demonic Jade Tower Master, Lin Yuan wouldn’t mind accessing more powerful beings’ understanding and views on space.

“Interested in going?”

“I have an invitation.”

The Great Scholar Tai’e asked again.

Not just anyone could listen to the Molang Scholar’s discourse. Only those who were Evolvers at the scholar level could receive an ‘invitation’.

Of course, if a particular Evolving Scholar didn’t want to participate, they could also gift their ‘invitation’ to other founders.

The Great Scholar Tai’e had such a plan in mind. If Lin Yuan asked a second time, he would not mind giving him the invitation.

“Invitation?”

Lin Yuan paused slightly.

Immediately, a virtual screen appeared, and upon opening the mail section, an invitation from the Molang Scholar was displayed.

“Are you referring to this invitation?”

Lin Yuan turned to look at the Great Scholar Tai’e.

“You?”

The Great Scholar Tai’e blinked several times, scrutinizing the invitation before finally turning to Lin Yuan in disbelief: “When did you become a scholar too?”
